"""Cache, snapshot and identity semantics with hand-computed traces."""
import copy, json, subprocess, sys

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"
def run_raw(req):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-u", MAIN],
                       input=json.dumps(req, separators=(",", ":")).encode(),
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp")
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[:500]
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

results = []
def eq(got, want, label):
    good = got == want
    results.append(good)
    print(("PASS " if good else "FAIL ") + label)
    if not good:
        print("   got     ", json.dumps(got))
        print("   expected", json.dumps(want))

def topo2(cap=100):
    return {"nodes":[{"id":0,"name":"A","external_capacity":cap},
                     {"id":1,"name":"B","external_capacity":cap}],
            "links":[{"source":0,"target":1,"capacity":cap}],
            "external_nodes":["A","B"]}
S2 = {"trials":2,"epsilon":0,"seed":7,"cutoff":[0,1],"bias":0,"tau":0,"gamma":[1,1],"cache_slots":2}
COUNTS = {"low_A_egress_to_B":{"perturbed":10},"low_B_ingress_from_A":{"perturbed":10},
          "low_B_egress_to_A":{"perturbed":3},"low_A_ingress_from_B":{"perturbed":3},
          "low_A_origination":{"perturbed":10},"low_A_termination":{"perturbed":3},
          "low_B_origination":{"perturbed":3},"low_B_termination":{"perturbed":10}}
DEM = [[0,1,10],[1,0,3]]
ROUTES = {"A":{"B":[{"path":["A","B"],"weight":1000}]},"B":{"A":[{"path":["B","A"],"weight":1000}]}}
ROUTES_REV = {"B":{"A":[{"path":["B","A"],"weight":1000}]},"A":{"B":[{"path":["A","B"],"weight":1000}]}}
ROUTES_SPLIT = {"A":{"B":[{"path":["A","B"],"weight":500},{"path":["A","B"],"weight":500}]},
                "B":{"A":[{"path":["B","A"],"weight":1000}]}}

def stream(events, settings=None, topology=None):
    return {"streams":[{"topology":topology or topo2(),
                        "settings":settings or dict(S2),"events":events}]}

# ---- cache semantics ----
evs = [
    {"op":"patch","demands":DEM,"counters":COUNTS},
    {"op":"routes","label":"L1","paths":ROUTES},
    {"op":"repair","id":"a"},
    {"op":"repair","id":"b"},                       # hit
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":{         # annotations only
        "low_A_origination":{"perturbed":10,"ground_truth":"noise","confidence":[9,9]},
        "low_A_termination":{"perturbed":3,"corrected":42}}},
    {"op":"repair","id":"c"},                       # hit: annotations ignored
    {"op":"routes","label":"other-label","paths":ROUTES_REV},  # same contents
    {"op":"repair","id":"d"},                       # hit: label/order ignored
    {"op":"routes","label":"L1","paths":ROUTES_SPLIT},        # split entries
    {"op":"repair","id":"e"},                       # miss: route identity changed
]
out = run_raw(stream(evs))["streams"][0]["events"]
flags = [e["cache_hit"] for e in out if e["op"] == "repair"]
eq(flags, [False, True, True, True, False], "cache_hit sequence (annotations/labels ignored; split changes key)")
for name in ("b","c","d"):
    a = [e for e in out if e.get("id") == "a"][0]
    b = [e for e in out if e.get("id") == name][0]
    eq(b["links"], a["links"], "hit returns same links: "+name)
    eq(b["order"], a["order"], "hit returns same order: "+name)
    eq(b["counters"], a["counters"], "hit returns same counters: "+name)
eq(sorted(out[-1]), sorted(["op","id","cache_hit","links","order","counters"]), "repair answer fields exact")

# ---- LRU eviction trace (slots=2): F F F T T F ----
def counter_state(v):
    c = dict(COUNTS); c["low_A_egress_to_B"] = {"perturbed": v}
    return c
evs = []
want = []
for step, (v, expect) in enumerate([(10, False), (11, False), (12, False), (12, True), (11, True), (10, False)]):
    evs.append({"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(v)})
    evs.append({"op":"repair","id":"u%d" % step})
    want.append(expect)
out = run_raw(stream(evs))["streams"][0]["events"]
eq([e["cache_hit"] for e in out if e["op"] == "repair"], want, "LRU trace slots=2 (hit refreshes recency)")

# ---- validate does not touch the cache (recency discrimination) ----
evs = [
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(10)}, {"op":"repair","id":"x1"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(11)}, {"op":"repair","id":"x2"},
    {"op":"validate","id":"x1"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(12)}, {"op":"repair","id":"x3"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(11)}, {"op":"repair","id":"x4"},  # k2 hit?
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(10)}, {"op":"repair","id":"x5"},  # k1 miss?
]
out = run_raw(stream(evs))["streams"][0]["events"]
eq([e["cache_hit"] for e in out if e["op"] == "repair"], [False, False, False, True, False],
   "validate neither accesses nor refreshes the cache")

# ---- frozen snapshots vs current inputs (hand-computed) ----
evs = [
    {"op":"patch","demands":DEM,"counters":COUNTS},
    {"op":"routes","label":"L","paths":ROUTES},
    {"op":"repair","id":"f"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[[0,1,40],[1,0,3]],"counters":{}},
    {"op":"validate","id":"f"},   # current demands, frozen values
    {"op":"routes","label":"L","paths":None},
    {"op":"validate","id":"f"},   # null routes: externals only
    {"op":"repair","id":"f"},     # replaces snapshot f
    {"op":"validate","id":"f"},
]
out = run_raw(stream(evs))["streams"][0]["events"]
eq(out[4], {"op":"validate","id":"f","checked":8,"passed":3,"consistent":False,
            "failed":["low_A_egress_to_B","low_A_origination","low_B_ingress_from_A","low_B_termination"]},
   "validate uses frozen values with current demands (hand-computed)")
eq(out[6], {"op":"validate","id":"f","checked":4,"passed":2,"consistent":False,
            "failed":["low_A_origination","low_B_termination"]},
   "null plan: external marginals only (hand-computed)")
eq(out[8], {"op":"validate","id":"f","checked":4,"passed":4,"consistent":True,"failed":[]},
   "repair with same id replaces snapshot")

# ---- snapshot independence & survival of eviction ----
evs = [
    {"op":"patch","demands":DEM,"counters":counter_state(10)},   # k1
    {"op":"repair","id":"s1"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(11)},    # k2
    {"op":"repair","id":"s2"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":counter_state(12)},    # k3 (evicts k1)
    {"op":"repair","id":"s3"},
    {"op":"patch","demands":[[0,1,40],[1,0,3]],"counters":{}},
    {"op":"validate","id":"s1"},
    {"op":"validate","id":"s2"},
]
out = run_raw(stream(evs))["streams"][0]["events"]
v1 = [e for e in out if e.get("id") == "s1" and e["op"] == "validate"][0]
v2 = [e for e in out if e.get("id") == "s2" and e["op"] == "validate"][0]
# s1 frozen at k1: (0,1) repaired to 10; s2 frozen at k1 too (only low_A_egress_to_B changed
# to 11; pools/evidence then disagree -> repaired value 10 or 11 band-dependent).
eq(v1, {"op":"validate","id":"s1","checked":8,"passed":3,"consistent":False,
        "failed":["low_A_egress_to_B","low_A_origination","low_B_ingress_from_A","low_B_termination"]},
   "evicted cache entry: snapshot s1 still validates (hand-computed)")

# ---- multi-stream independence ----
req = {"streams":[
    {"topology":topo2(),"settings":dict(S2, cache_slots=0),
     "events":[{"op":"patch","demands":DEM,"counters":COUNTS},{"op":"repair","id":"m"},
               {"op":"repair","id":"m2"}]},
    {"topology":topo2(),"settings":dict(S2, cache_slots=2),
     "events":[{"op":"patch","demands":DEM,"counters":COUNTS},{"op":"repair","id":"m"},
               {"op":"repair","id":"m2"}]},
]}
out = run_raw(req)["streams"]
eq([e["cache_hit"] for e in out[0]["events"]], [False, False], "stream 0: cache_slots=0 always misses")
eq([e["cache_hit"] for e in out[1]["events"]], [False, True], "stream 1: independent memoization")
eq(out[0]["events"][1]["links"], out[1]["events"][1]["links"], "streams compute the same repair")

print()
print("ALL OK" if all(results) else "SOME FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)
EOF
